name: She Yingjie
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2021-2026); Hurun China (2020-2026)
forbes_bio: She Yingjie chairs China's Olympic Circuit Technology.
Founded in 1985, the company produces a variety of printed circuit boards.
Olympic went public at the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2017.

name: Eric Jing
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2021); Hurun Unicorn founders (2026)
forbes_bio: Eric Jing is the executive chairman of financial services firm Ant Group, an affiliate of China  e-commerce giant Alibaba Group.
Jing was chief executive officer of the company from October 2016 to December 2019.
China regulators held up Ant's planned dual listing in Shanghai and Hong Kong on regulatory concerns on Nov. 3, 2020.

name: Wong Luen Hei
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2001-2025); Hurun Global (2022-2024)
forbes_bio: Wong Luen Hei chairs Hong Kong-listed China Lesso, a supplier of building materials and interior decorations products like pipes and windows.
Wong's wife Zuo Xiaoping and brother-in-law Zuo Manlun sit on Lesso's board.
Lesso is headquartered in the southern Chinese city of Foshan.

name: Dmitry Alexeyev
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2026)
forbes_bio: Dmitry Alexeyev is a cofounder of DNS Retail, the largest consumer electronics retailer in Russia, which he started with fellow billionaire Yuri Karptsov.
The duo established its first store in 1998 and didn't open a second one until 2005.
Today DNS Retail has more than 2,700 stores and 39,000 employees.
forbes_facts: DNS stands for Digital Network Systems.

name: Cameron Mackintosh
appears_on: Forbes annual (2016); Sunday Times Rich List (2020)

name: Li Shui-po
forbes_bio: Li Shui-po is the chairman of Kinglai Hygienic Materials, a maker of  food aseptic packaging materials and stainless steel products such as vacuum chambers, pumps and pipe fittings.
Li founded Kinglai in Taiwan in 1991 and moved its headquarters to Kunshan, Jiangsu province in 2000.
The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2011.

name: Xia Heng
appears_on: Hurun Global (2021-2022); Hurun China (2018-2021); Hurun Global U40 (2022); Hurun China U40 (2019-2021); Hurun Unicorn founders (2020)

name: Giannis Alafouzos
forbes_bio: Giannis Alafouzos is the founder and chairman of Okeanis Eco Tankers, an Athens-based shipping company that owns 15 oil tankers.
He founded the firm in 2018 and took it public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2023.
Alongside his brother Themistocles, he co-owns Kyklades Maritime Corporation, an Athens-based shipping firm with 24 vessels.
He's also the president and majority owner of Skai Group, a Greek media conglomerate with interests in TV, radio stations and news sites.
Alafouzos is also the president and majority owner of Greek soccer team Panathinaikos.

name: Mofatraj Munot
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2011-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Hurun India (2015-2019)
forbes_bio: Mumbai real estate magnate Mofatraj Munot started developing property in 1969 after working with his uncle.
Munot snatched lucrative construction contracts during the 1970s in the Middle East oil boom, where he built the palace of the ruler of Sharjah.
Today, his Kalpataru, run by son Parag, has completed more than 110 projects in nine cities.
In July 2025, he listed the property development arm, Kalpataru. Engineering contractor Kalpataru Projects International, is Munot's other listed asset.
forbes_facts: The name Kalpataru is derived from Kalpavruksha, a mythological tree of wish fulfillment.
Munot is fond of Urdu poetry.

name: Jens von Bahr
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2022-2025); Hurun Global (2023-2026)
forbes_bio: Jens von Bahr cofounded publicly traded casino supplier Evolution AB with Fredrik 'sterberg in 2006.
He was CEO of Evolutions until 2016 and is now chairman of the company, which primarily sells live-streamed tables of blackjack, poker, craps and roulette to online gambling operators.
The company went public in Stockholm in 2015 and now provides its services to over 700 customers in 21 countries. Evolution's products are available globally for end users.
Evolution's first casino studio was set up in Riga, Lithuania. Today the company has live-casino studios in nine countries, including the U.S.
Before starting Evolution, von Bahr headed the Sri Lankan operations of Oriflame, a Swiss-Swedish multi-level marketing company that sells beauty products.
forbes_facts: The land of Von Bahr's house is owned the king of Sweden; he was denied permission to build a pool on the property.

name: Yunfeng Ke
forbes_bio: Ke Yunfeng is the chairman of Dashenlin Pharmaceutical Group.
Dashenlin went public at the Shanghai Stock Exchange on 2017.
The company opened its first store in the southern Chinese city of Zhenjiang in 1999; it has more than 4,000 today.
Dashenlin has more than 23,000 employees.

name: Suat Gunsel
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2021); Forbes annual (2007-2020); Hurun Global (2014-2021)
forbes_bio: Suat Gunsel owns the largest education facility in Northern Cyprus, Near East University, which serves around 30,000 students.
The campus, in the capitol city of Nicosia (a.k.a. Lefkosia), occupies a prime piece of his real estate portfolio, which includes holdings in Turkey.
The university has spun out an electric vehicle venture. The Gunsel B9 model, introduced in February 2020, can go almost 220 miles on a single charge.
In 2013, Gunsel opened a second university in Girne (University of Kyrenia), on the north coast of Cyprus.
Gunsel also operates in banking, health, tourism, real estate development and liquid fuel distribution.
forbes_facts: In 2018, Gunsel inaugurated the Cyprus Modern Art Museum. Emphasizing artists from Turkic states, its collection comprises some 20,000 paintings and sculptures.
Gunsel's Near East Automobile Museum exhibits over 100 modern and classic cars, the oldest of which is an 1899 model Crestmobile.
